docdesc_premi_dynamic_exclude.description: Get dynamic premi headers from PR_ADTRANS excluding specific patterns
docdesc_premi_dynamic_exclude.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.DocDesc FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%POT%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BERAS%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%JABATAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%MASA%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%SPSI%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%PPH%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%KOREKSI%' AND t.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.DocDesc

docdesc_premi_dynamic_with_amounts.description: Get dynamic premi data with amounts for payroll calculation
docdesc_premi_dynamic_with_amounts.sql: SELECT t.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%POT%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BERAS%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%JABATAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%MASA%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%SPSI%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%PPH%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%KOREKSI%' GROUP BY t.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) DESC

docdesc_potongan_kotor_include.description: Get potongan upah kotor from PR_ADTRANS including 'pot' pattern
docdesc_potongan_kotor_include.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.DocDesc FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KOREKSI%') AND t.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.DocDesc

docdesc_potongan_kotor_with_amounts.description: Get potongan upah kotor data with amounts for payroll calculation
docdesc_potongan_kotor_with_amounts.sql: SELECT t.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KOREKSI%') GROUP BY t.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) DESC

docdesc_potongan_bersih_conditional.description: Get conditional potongan upah bersih headers (SPSI, PPH21, Tiket, Kontan, Pinjam, Alat, THR) excluding BPJS, ASTEK, KESEHATAN
docdesc_potongan_bersih_conditional.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.DocDesc FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%SPSI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%TIKET%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KONTAN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PINJAM%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%ALAT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%THR%') AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%MAJIKAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%TOTAL%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%JUMLAH%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BPJS%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%ASTEK%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%KESEHATAN%' AND t.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.DocDesc

docdesc_potongan_bersih_with_amounts.description: Get conditional potongan upah bersih data with amounts excluding total/majikan/jumlah/BPJS/ASTEK/KESEHATAN patterns
docdesc_potongan_bersih_with_amounts.sql: SELECT t.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%SPSI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%TIKET%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KONTAN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PINJAM%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%ALAT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%THR%') AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%MAJIKAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%TOTAL%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%JUMLAH%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BPJS%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%ASTEK%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%KESEHATAN%' GROUP BY t.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) DESC

docdesc_all_potongan_bersih_sum.description: Cell-based aggregation total untuk semua potongan upah bersih (exclude majikan, total, jumlah)
docdesc_all_potongan_bersih_sum.sql: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalPotonganBersih FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND COALESCE(ln.Amount,0) > 0 AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%SPSI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KOREKSI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%BPJS%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PINJAM%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KL%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%TIKET%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%KONTAN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%ALAT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%THR%') AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%MAJIKAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%TOTAL%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%JUMLAH%'

docdesc_lembur_taskreg.description: Get lembur data from PR_TASKREG (separate from PR_ADTRANS logic)
docdesc_lembur_taskreg.sql: SELECT DISTINCT tr.DocDesc FROM PR_TASKREG_ARC AS tr JOIN PR_TASKREGLN_ARC AS trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = tr.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND tr.TaskDate >= ? AND tr.TaskDate < ? AND COALESCE(trl.Amount,0) > 0 AND tr.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tr.DocDesc

docdesc_lembur_with_amounts.description: Get lembur data with amounts from PR_TASKREG
docdesc_lembur_with_amounts.sql: SELECT tr.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(trl.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_TASKREG_ARC AS tr JOIN PR_TASKREGLN_ARC AS trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = tr.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND tr.TaskDate >= ? AND tr.TaskDate < ? AND COALESCE(trl.Amount,0) > 0 GROUP BY tr.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(trl.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(trl.Amount,0)) DESC

docdesc_brondol_loosefruit.description: Get brondol loosefruit data from PR_LOOSEFRUIT
docdesc_brondol_loosefruit.sql: SELECT lf.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(lfl.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_LOOSEFRUIT_ARC AS lf JOIN PR_LOOSEFRUITLN_ARC AS lfl ON lf.ID = lfl.LoosefruitID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = lf.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND lf.LoosefruitDate >= ? AND lf.LoosefruitDate < ? AND COALESCE(lfl.Amount,0) > 0 GROUP BY lf.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(lfl.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(lfl.Amount,0)) DESC

docdesc_field_mapping.description: Map DocDesc to field names based on pattern matching
docdesc_field_mapping.sql: SELECT DISTINCT DocDesc, CASE WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%BERAS%' THEN 'beras' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%JABATAN%' THEN 'jabatan' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%MASA%' THEN 'masa_kerja' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%LEMBUR%' THEN 'lembur' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%SPSI%' THEN 'spsi' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%' THEN 'pph21' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%KOREKSI%' THEN 'koreksi' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%TIKET%' THEN 'tiket' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%KONTAN%' THEN 'kontan' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%PINJAM%' THEN 'pinjam' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%ALAT%' THEN 'alat_panen' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%THR%' THEN 'thr' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%POT%' THEN 'potongan_dinamis' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%BRONDOL%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%LOOSEFRUIT%' THEN 'brondol_loosefruit' ELSE 'premi_dinamis' END AS field_mapping, CASE WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%BERAS%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%JABATAN%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%MASA%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%LEMBUR%' THEN 'tunjangan' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%SPSI%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%KOREKSI%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%POT%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%TIKET%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%KONTAN%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%PINJAM%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%ALAT%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%THR%' THEN 'potongan' WHEN UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%BRONDOL%' OR UPPER(DocDesc) LIKE '%LOOSEFRUIT%' THEN 'premi_fixed' ELSE 'premi_dynamic' END AS category FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC WHERE DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DocDesc

lembur_detail.description: Get detailed daily overtime matrix with amounts for each employee
lembur_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.Hours as hours, trl.Amount as amount, trl.Rate as rate, trl.TaskCode as task_code, trl.NormalDay as normal_day, trl.ShiftCode as shift_code, tr.DocDesc as description, CASE WHEN trl.NormalDay = 0 THEN 'Hari Libur' WHEN trl.NormalDay = 2 THEN 'Hari Minggu' ELSE 'Hari Kerja' END as day_type FROM PR_TASKREG{table_suffix} tr JOIN PR_TASKREGLN{table_suffix} trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 1 ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

lembur_detail_bygang.description: Get detailed daily overtime matrix for all employees in a gang
lembur_detail_bygang.sql: SELECT e.EmpCode as nik, e.EmpName as nama, DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.Hours as hours, trl.Amount as amount, trl.Rate as rate, trl.TaskCode as task_code, trl.NormalDay as normal_day, trl.ShiftCode as shift_code, tr.DocDesc as description, CASE WHEN trl.NormalDay = 0 THEN 'Hari Libur' WHEN trl.NormalDay = 2 THEN 'Hari Minggu' ELSE 'Hari Kerja' END as day_type FROM HR_GANGLN g JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON g.GangMember = e.EmpCode JOIN PR_TASKREG{table_suffix} tr ON tr.EmpCode = e.EmpCode JOIN PR_TASKREGLN{table_suffix} trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 1 ORDER BY e.EmpCode, trl.TrxDate

lembur_summary_employee.description: Get overtime summary for an employee with total hours and amounts
lembur_summary_employee.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trl.TrxDate) as total_days, SUM(trl.Hours) as total_hours, SUM(trl.Amount) as total_amount, AVG(trl.Rate) as avg_rate, COUNT(trl.ID) as total_transactions FROM PR_TASKREG{table_suffix} tr JOIN PR_TASKREGLN{table_suffix} trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 1

lembur_summary_bygang.description: Get overtime summary for all employees in a gang
lembur_summary_bygang.sql: SELECT e.EmpCode as nik, e.EmpName as nama, COUNT(DISTINCT trl.TrxDate) as total_days, SUM(trl.Hours) as total_hours, SUM(trl.Amount) as total_amount, AVG(trl.Rate) as avg_rate, COUNT(trl.ID) as total_transactions FROM HR_GANGLN g JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON g.GangMember = e.EmpCode JOIN PR_TASKREG{table_suffix} tr ON tr.EmpCode = e.EmpCode JOIN PR_TASKREGLN{table_suffix} trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 1 GROUP BY e.EmpCode, e.EmpName ORDER BY e.EmpCode

lembur_types_detail.description: Get detailed overtime by task type/description for an employee
lembur_types_detail.sql: SELECT tr.DocDesc as overtime_type, COUNT(DISTINCT trl.TrxDate) as days, SUM(trl.Hours) as total_hours, SUM(trl.Amount) as total_amount, AVG(trl.Rate) as avg_rate, COUNT(trl.ID) as transactions FROM PR_TASKREG{table_suffix} tr JOIN PR_TASKREGLN{table_suffix} trl ON tr.ID = trl.TaskRegID WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 1 GROUP BY tr.DocDesc HAVING SUM(trl.Amount) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(trl.Amount) DESC
